items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: he was working out in San Francisco with a man called King Guglio and Earl Hans.

ctx.x: Well, he was working out in San Francisco with a man called King Guglio and Earl Hans. And I guess they didn't like his style because how that all started, they was working, during that time, the whole band was working at the paddock. Which band?
